accepted_core: Existence of independent positive scalar-noise laws with finite variance pair (v1,v2) iff v1>0,v2>0,v1*v2>=norm([A,B])^2 for noncommuting bounded involutions scaled by a,b>0.
scope_corrections: Variance product is an existence region, not positivity criterion for every law with those variances.
For specified independent laws use the essential likelihood-contrast criterion.
Noncommuting assumption is needed for positive coordinate variances and geometric boundary classification.
No dependent-noise variance bound is inferred.
Finite rectangle half-widths should be stated as positive and finite.

decisive_countermodel.analytic_status: Negative on an open set with strictly positive reference density

closest_prior_correction: Geng-Viswanath arXiv:1212.1186v3 Section VI-C Theorem 11 proves geometric optimality for unit-sensitivity integer additive noise and symmetric monotone costs including squared error; do not cite only its continuous staircase theorem.
information: Exact geometric reports and known four-effect sign POVM are statistically equivalent by two state-independent Markov kernels; added magnitudes contain no quantum information.
cost: Conditioning signs halves each added reporting variance. Exact reports have unbounded support; finite clipping changes the characteristic identity. Norm acquisition, physical instrument and exact finite-bit sampler not acquired.
